why: the breeding stock's traces: six public-domain books, downloaded 2026-10-29 from Project Gutenberg with Simon's go-ahead, kept byte for byte (CRLF and Project Gutenberg's own header and licence included). Each mind is grown only from the span of its book that is the author's own words: from its start heading to its end heading (each matched as a whole line, trimmed, at the occurrence given, counted from the Project Gutenberg start marker), never an editor's introduction, notes or contents.
note: these are MODELS of thought-patterns grown from public texts: not the people, not resurrections, not conscious beings. Jung was left out: his works are still in copyright in the UK until 2031.
